additional_info.text: Reaction conditions: 1a (0.50 mmol), MeOH (2 mL), CH3CN (4 mL), ligand (0.5 mmol) and catalyst (0.05 mmol); the reaction mixture was irradiated with blue LEDs (40 mW cm-2 at 460 nm) at RT for 12 h under O2 (1 atm).
Other copper salts such as CuX (X = Cl, Br).
MeOH (4 mL) was used both as the reactant and solvent.
Under ambient white light irradiation (12 h, 8 mW cm-2 at 460 nm).
At room temperature and in the dark.
